newsitem.title: MEXICO: Screen trading only for Mexican stocks after fire.
newsitem.headline: Screen trading only for Mexican stocks after fire.

text.p: Open outcry trading was suspended on the main floor of the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV) Friday and replaced by screen trading following a fire Thursday evening, the BMV said.
The BMV said no one was harmed during the fire, which occurred in an electricity substation in the Stock Exchange basement shortly after the close of trade on Thursday.

"As a precautionary measure, and with the aim of checking installations...all securities traded on the BMV will be done so from brokerages' offices," a BMV news statement said, adding the Bolsa's SENTRA screen trading system would be used.
Traders noted several trial runs had already been succesfully conducted using SENTRA.
BMV employees said by telephone they expected normal trading to resume on Monday.
